# cuRobo source

- Upstream: [NVlabs/curobo](https://github.com/NVlabs/curobo).
- Paper: [cuRoboV2: Dynamics-Aware Motion Generation with Depth-Fused Distance Fields for High-DoF Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05493).
- Source: a bundled source snapshot; its upstream commit is not recorded.
- Licenses: [Apache-2.0 source license](LICENSE) and [asset-specific terms](LICENSE_ASSETS), with additional notices in robot asset directories.

TARSphere integrates cuRobo through its manipulation adapters and separate execution process. No separate TARSphere patch is recorded for this source directory. Native extensions are built on the target machine. Original copyright and dependency notices are retained; the source license does not replace the asset-specific terms.
